summary: Sprint 1 completed with all planned implementation, QA, and security tasks marked done.
decisions: Retrospective dialogue: Manager — “The database-to-backend-to-frontend handoffs completed in dependency order, and no planned work was duplicated.” Database — “The required task schema was already compatible with the authenticated API, so I verified it rather than changing it.” Backend — “The task lifecycle API and ownership checks were present and the five API tests passed.” Frontend — “The existing single-file UI already covered creation, movement, editing, deletion, and authenticated API use.” QA — “All 12 automated tests passed; a real socket smoke test could not run because the sandbox rejected local TCP binding.” Security — “I added browser response security headers, then verified them alongside the full passing test suite.” Architect — “No Sprint 1 architect completion report or blocker appears in the supplied log.”
